content: Xoossa Keeth Keexxana Solomoone Giigeteth
Xiroose Kawo Kiraamey Dawitera ba diza layth ubbaan siiqon gam7ida gishshas Solomooney ba aawa Dawite sohon kawotanaas tiyettidayssa siyidi ba oosanchchata Solomoonekko kiittides.
Solomooneykka Kiraames zaaridi,
«Ta aawaa Dawite bolla ubbasora dendida olaa gaason GODAY iza morkketa iza tohoppe garsara haarisana gakkanaas GODAA ba Xoossaa sunththaas Keeththe izi keexxana dandayontta aggidayssa ne eraasa.
Ha7i gidikko GODAA ta Xoossay taas ubbasora saroteth immida gishshas taas morkkey woykko iita miishshi deenna.
GODAY ta aawa Dawites, ‹Tani ne sohon ne kawoteththa araatan kawoththiza ne nay ta sunththas Keeth keexxana› gida mala tani GODAA ta Xoossaa sunththas Xoossa keeth keexxanaas qoppadis.

Hessa gishshas Libaanooseppe ziga taas qanxxiza asata azaza; ta asati ne asatara ooththana; ne asatas neni qanxxa gida damoza tani qanxxana. Sidoona asaa mala miththa qanxxo hiilla nu asay eronttayssa neni eraasa» gi kiittides.
Kiraamey Solomoone kiitaza siyidi keehippe ufayettidi, «Ha wolqqama deraa ayssanaas Dawites aadho erateththan kumida naa immida GODAY hach galatetto» gides.
Hessafe guye Kiraamey Solomoones, «Neni taas kiittida kiitay tana gakkides. Neni koyidayssa ubbaa tani ooththana; ziga mudeththatanne
xiidda mudeththata tani nees shiishshana.

Ta asay mudeththata Libaanooseppe duge abba mata gakkanaas miiyana; tanikka istta qachcha caanada abbaa bollara tookettidi neni malatidaso gaththada ta birshisana; neni heeppe ekkada ne baggara ta kawoteththa keeththan diza asaas miza kath yeddada ta amo kunththa» gi kiittides.
Hessaththo ooththidi Kiraamey Solomooney koyida keena ziga mudeththatanne xiidda mudeththata ubbaa shiishshides.
Solomooneykka kawo Kiraame kawoteththa keeththan diza asatas qallaba gidana mala 20,000 konttaale gisttenne muuruta wogara zayte 400,000 litiro layththan layththan pacey baynda Kiraames shiishshees.
GODAY Solomoones immida hidota qaalaa mala izas aadho erateth immides. Kiraamessinne Solomoones lo7o gaytoteththi diza gishshas bantta giddon caaqettida.
Kawo Solomooney Isra7eele asa ubbaafe 30,000 gabbarata doorides.

Adooniraame istta bolla halaqa histti shuumides. Gabbaratakka tammu tammu shiyan shaakki heedzdzu kessides; issi issi buttey issi agina Libaanoosen ooththana malanne nam7u agina bason bason shempana mala tara oyththides.
Solomoones tooho tookkiza 70,000 asatinne shuch qeriza 80,000 asati gezzen deettes.
Qasseka oosoza aawateththan kaaletti oosisiza 33,000 alaafeti deettes.
Isttika Kawo Solomooney azaziin Xoossa Keeththaas yoch gidana mala wogga muuruta shuchchata qeridi massida.
Kushe hiillateth eriza Solomoone asati, Kiraame asatinne Gebaale asati Xoossa Keeththaas koshshiza miththinne shuch qeri giigsida.

footnotes.text: Mudeththa: Mudeththa issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan ciireth woykko cuketh geetettees.
